title: Traveling through an airport

examples.learner: Yes, I have one small bag.

common_misunderstandings.explanation_bg: За посока се използва ‘fly to’, а не ‘fly in’.

prompts: Say: I am flying to London.
Good morning. What is your destination?
exercises.explanation_bg: Кажете ‘flying to’ и след това града, към който пътувате.

prompts: Say: I have one small bag as hand luggage.
Do you have any hand luggage?
Tell the check-in agent what you will take into the cabin.
exercises.gentle_correction: Name the bag that stays with you in the cabin.
exercises.explanation_bg: ‘Hand luggage’ е багажът, който вземате със себе си в самолета.

prompts: Ask: Where is gate twelve, please?
Your boarding pass says gate twelve. Ask for directions.
Boarding starts soon and you cannot find gate twelve. What do you ask?
exercises.gentle_correction: Ask where the gate is and include its number if you know it.
exercises.explanation_bg: ‘Gate’ е изходът за качване. Попитайте ‘Where is gate ...?’.

completion_condition: Complete check-in, luggage, and gate tasks in English.
